query: find an unused network port on the local machine
compare two version strings
notes: is_version_greater is a thin boolean wrapper over compare_versions; counted relevant since calling it answers 'compare'. max_version/min_version, VersionKey dunder methods and rank_issues._version_key (private, 3-int tuple) judged not relevant.

query: decode a JWT payload without verifying the signature
notes: Private duplicates of the same logic exist (utilities/auth.py _decode_jwt_part, identity_assertion._decode_unverified_claims at 522) but are private helpers; judged not relevant. decode_jwt_header decodes the header, not payload.

query: paginate a list of items using a cursor
notes: Judged as server-side slicing with an opaque cursor. Client-side 'fetch all pages' helpers (Context._paginate_list, Client.list_tools) and private mcp_operations._apply_pagination (wrapper raising MCPError) judged not relevant.

query: extract parameter descriptions from a function's docstring
build a validating Python type from a schema dictionary
notes: json_schema_to_type_adapter returns a cached validating TypeAdapter built from json_schema_to_type; counted relevant. cli/apps_dev._model_from_schema builds a pydantic model but is private to the dev UI; not relevant. Underscore helpers in json_schema_type.py are internals.

query: inline all references so a schema has no pointers left
notes: resolve_root_ref only resolves a root-level $ref (not relevant). compress_schema(dereference=True) delegates to dereference_refs but is a compressor; not counted. server/middleware/dereference helpers are private per-component wrappers.

query: block outgoing requests to private or internal network addresses
notes: ssrf_safe_fetch (374) was outside the pool and added. is_ip_allowed only judges an IP string, borderline but counted as a reusable building block; validate_url checks URL+resolved IPs. HostOriginGuardMiddleware is inbound protection, not relevant.

query: run startup and shutdown hooks from several apps together
notes: Inner closure combine_lifespans.combined (line 46) holds the logic but is not callable on its own; not relevant.

query: call blocking code from async code without stalling the loop
notes: without_injected_parameters has run_in_thread but is a different, DI-specific wrapper; not relevant.

query: escape a command argument so the Windows shell treats it literally
notes: windows_batch_command_line builds a whole command line with each argument quoted literally; counted relevant. run_cli_command runs a command (not an escaper) and _quote_batch_text is private; not relevant.

query: read the YAML header block at the top of a markdown file
notes: Intended target skills/_snapshot.py:58 judged NOT relevant: it validates against Agent Skills schema (requires name/description) and would reject generic markdown frontmatter. _common.parse_frontmatter is the generic helper (returns dict + body).

query: fill placeholders in a resource address pattern with values
notes: openapi/director._build_url is OpenAPI path templating (private, different syntax); not relevant.

query: append extra key-value pairs to a link's query string
notes: replace_query_param replaces an existing key rather than appending; build_client_redirect is specific to OAuth iss handling; not relevant.

query: flatten nested exception groups into individual errors
throttle how many calls a client can make per second
notes: TokenBucketRateLimiter.consume (109) was outside the pool and added. Judged on whether calling it enforces a per-second limit: consume, SlidingWindowRateLimiter.is_allowed (window_seconds=1) and RateLimitingMiddleware.on_request. Constructors and the minutes-granularity SlidingWindowRateLimitingMiddleware judged not relevant.

query: save JSON to disk atomically with owner-only permissions
notes: CredentialStore.save / ConfigurationStore.save call write_state but are specific to Horizon models; not relevant. MCPConfig.write_to_file is not atomic and not permission-restricted.

query: gzip compress an HTTP response body
notes: Unanswerable confirmed: no gzip/zlib use in indexed code; compress_schema compresses JSON schemas, not HTTP bodies.

query: compute the next run time from a cron expression
notes: Unanswerable confirmed: croniter is only referenced in a benchmark script import; no cron/next-run helper in indexed code (_next_poll_delay is poll backoff).

query: validate that a string is a well-formed email address
notes: Unanswerable confirmed: no email validator; json_schema_type maps format=email to pydantic EmailStr inside schema conversion, not a standalone check.

query: get the JSON out of an LLM reply wrapped in markdown fences
notes: extract_json_from_stream (added, outside pool) takes an iterable of text chunks and prefers fenced markdown output; passing [reply_text] satisfies the need, so labelled relevant but borderline. Private _last_json_span and _MultiModelStream.feed judged not relevant (private internals behind the public functions).

query: work out the dollar cost of a request from token counts
notes: get_model_cost only returns per-token price, does not compute a dollar cost, so not relevant.

query: list the links referenced in a markdown document
notes: Both extract markdown links but only internal ones (external, mailto and anchors skipped); labelled relevant with that caveat. make_sitemap version also rewrites paths to .md/index.md, so it is the more adapted of the two.

query: check if a callable is async, even through decorators or partials
convert a TypedDict class into a pydantic model
notes: _typed_dict_to_model is private but is exactly the converter. prepare_response_model also converts TypedDicts but as one step of a much broader normalisation that returns a wrapped runtime model; judged not relevant. is_typed_dict only detects.

query: tell whether a partially streamed payload is finished and parseable
notes: JsonCompleteness.analyze/is_root_complete can answer it too but need a two-step stateful call and report per-path completeness; judged not relevant.

query: strip invisible characters that break parsing of streamed text
notes: remove_control_chars is the direct answer. _JsonControlCharSanitizer.__call__ is a private stateful per-chunk sanitiser (also drops DEL/C1 outside strings), labelled relevant but borderline as a private class. scripts/make_clean.clean_markdown_content strips zero-width chars but is a markdown doc cleaner, not for streamed JSON; not relevant.

query: join back-to-back chat turns from the same speaker
deterministic fingerprint for deduplicating identical LLM requests
notes: Both hash a request into a deterministic SHA-256 key; make_request_cache_key hashes the full prepared request, make_cache_key the main components. client_cache_identity only builds an identity dict; not relevant.

query: download a remote file without allowing requests to internal hosts
notes: Image.url_to_base64 is a thin image-only wrapper returning base64; judged not relevant for a generic file download (borderline). _validate_public_url/_request_with_redirects are private building blocks.

query: guess whether a path or link is a picture, audio, or document
notes: Per-type autodetect_safely methods (Image/Audio/PDF) only test one type; not relevant.

query: disallow undeclared keys everywhere in a JSON schema
notes: core.schema.make_strict_schema is a thin wrapper around the openai one; calling it does the job so labelled relevant (both were in the pool). Bedrock _prepare_bedrock_strict_schema also sets additionalProperties=false recursively but is private, takes a model, and rejects many constraints; not relevant.

query: read the YAML header block at the top of a markdown page
notes: Hand-rolled regex extractor that returns only title/description/keywords, not the whole header; labelled relevant but borderline.

query: locate roughly where a quoted sentence appears in a passage
notes: CitationMixin._get_span is a private method but is the fuzzy quote locator. get_spans needs an instance carrying substring_quotes; judged not relevant.

query: fill in placeholder variables inside prompt messages
notes: None of the three relevant functions were in the pool (found by reading core/templating.py; pool only had per-provider helpers). apply_template (Jinja render of a string), process_message (one message, any provider format) and handle_templating (all messages in request kwargs) all satisfy it. Per-provider process_message helpers (openai/anthropic/gemini/cohere/genai/vertexai templating.py) and render_text_blocks handle one format and need the renderer passed in; judged not relevant (borderline).

query: write output to a temporary file then swap it into place
notes: _atomic_result_file is private but is a generic context manager for exactly this; labelled relevant.

query: running total of tokens consumed over repeated model calls
notes: Anthropic-only update_total_usage accumulates and is labelled relevant (borderline, one provider); _accumulate_models is the private generic accumulator, not relevant.

query: estimate how many tokens a prompt will consume before sending
notes: Checked by grep and by reading the pool: no token estimation/tokenizer in indexed code. _usage_total_tokens only reads a total already on a usage object; calculate_cost needs token counts as input.

query: split a long document into overlapping chunks
notes: Checked by grep: no text splitting/chunking helper for documents; all 'chunk' hits are about streaming response chunks.

query: compute cosine similarity between two embedding vectors
notes: Checked by grep: no cosine similarity, dot product or embedding code in indexed code.

query: convert text into a URL-safe slug
notes: sanitize_tool_name (string_utils.py:26, not pooled) does a similar normalisation but is tool-name specific (fixed '_', 64-char truncation with hash suffix); judged not relevant.

query: compute the SHA-256 hash of a string
notes: generate_doc_id(content=s) returns sha256(s) hex, so calling it satisfies the need (wrapper rule) - borderline. _AuthStore.compute_key hashes 'type:data' (not a plain string hash); file-hash helpers take files/chunks, not strings: not relevant.

query: split long text into overlapping chunks
notes: Borderline: the seven identical *KnowledgeSource._chunk_text methods are private but do exactly overlapping fixed-size chunking (step = size - overlap), labelled relevant. chunk_text takes a TextFile (trivial wrap). RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter internals (_split_text, _merge_splits, _split_by_characters, no overlap) not relevant; the public split_text covers them.

query: extract the video id from a YouTube URL
parse JSON that contains comments and trailing commas
notes: strip_jsonc_comments + json.loads is trivial adaptation. _load_jsonc (cli) parses a JSONC file (path input). load_jsonc_file added from outside the pool. _strip_jsonc_comments / _strip_trailing_commas each handle only half the need: not relevant. _safe_repair_json uses json_repair for agent tool input: not relevant.

query: keep outgoing calls under a fixed number per minute
notes: Borderline: BraveSearchToolBase._rate_limit is a generic thread-safe min-interval throttle (requests per second; set rps=N/60), but a private method of a search tool - labelled relevant. enforce_rpm_limit only calls the callable it is given (wrapper that does not satisfy the need alone): not relevant. Nested _check_and_increment not relevant.

query: tell whether a network address points to an internal host
notes: _is_local_collector / _encrypted check loopback/localhost only, not private ranges: not relevant. validate_url (safe_path.py:225, not pooled) resolves a URL and rejects private IPs, but is URL-fetch validation with scheme checks; judged not relevant (borderline).

query: guess what kind of file some raw bytes are
notes: URLReadTool._sniff is a staticmethod identifying pdf/docx/xlsx/html/text from bytes: relevant. _fallback_content_type(None, data) sniffs bytes: relevant (borderline, private). FileBytes._detect_content_type is a model validator, _resolve_kind is tool dispatch: not relevant.

query: shrink a picture so it fits within a maximum size
notes: Query is ambiguous between max dimensions and max file size: resize_image (dimensions, intended) and optimize_image (reduce quality to fit a byte budget) both labelled relevant. FileProcessor._auto_process_image is private orchestration needing processor constraints: not relevant.

query: convert a 1-based index into Excel-style letters like AA
notes: _cell_index does the inverse (letters to index): not relevant.

query: fill in named placeholders in a template without breaking JSON braces
notes: Borderline: render_template fills {{name}} placeholders in a template file (used for .jsonc templates) and leaves other braces alone; takes a Path, labelled relevant. Expression.render_template is CEL ${...} evaluation and Task/Crew interpolation methods are object-specific: not relevant.

query: recognise an error caused by the prompt being too long for the model
notes: Intended public helper is_context_length_exceeded (agent_utils.py:997) was NOT in the pool; added outside the pool. is_context_window_overflowing_threshold is a proactive size check, not error recognition: not relevant.

query: pull a JSON object out of chatty model output
notes: handle_partial_json, _fit_response_model, _validate_structured_output all extract JSON but require a pydantic model (and may call an LLM): not relevant. extract_a2ui_json_objects only keeps A2UI objects: not relevant. post_process_result only extracts when an output format is configured: not relevant.

query: make arbitrary Python objects safe to dump as JSON
notes: to_string and handlers._serialize are json.dumps(to_serializable(x)) wrappers that satisfy the need. CrewJSONEncoder.default (not pooled) raises for unknown types, so not 'arbitrary': not relevant. _is_json_serializable only checks; _serialize_static_value is flow-definition specific: not relevant.

query: how long to wait before the next attempt after being throttled
notes: Several functions compute a wait: Retry-After readers (_retry_delay, _retry_after, _retry_after_seconds) and backoff calculators (get_retry_delay_seconds, gemini _compute_backoff_delay; the latter is plain backoff, borderline). Retry loops (run_with_rate_limit_retry, MCP retry helpers) perform retries rather than return the delay: not relevant.

query: check a signed login token against the identity provider's public keys
notes: OIDCAuth.authenticate verifies a JWT against the issuer's JWKS: relevant. OAuth2ServerAuth.authenticate does so when jwks_url is configured (else introspection): borderline relevant; its private _authenticate_jwt is covered by it. _validate_and_save_token is CLI login with side effects; verify_agent_card_signature verifies agent cards, not login tokens: not relevant.

query: turn strings like 7d or 24h into a time span
notes: WaitTool._resolve_duration clamps numeric seconds, does not parse '7d': not relevant.

query: convert a markdown document to HTML
notes: Verified unanswerable: no indexed function converts Markdown to HTML (MDX loader strips JSX to text; SerplyWebpageToMarkdownTool is the reverse direction).

query: send an email through an SMTP server
notes: Verified unanswerable: no SMTP/email-sending function in indexed code (only 'gmail/send_email' as an example string for platform apps).

query: parse a cron expression and compute the next run time
notes: Verified unanswerable: no cron parsing or scheduling code (no croniter/crontab usage).
